key_idea: The board is at most 25 cells, so enumerate ship placements as bitmasks with backtracking; a size-1 ship has one orientation only.
sketch: Precompute for every ship the list of placement masks (horizontal and, if length > 1, vertical) that avoid every X cell. Recurse over ships in order, choosing a placement disjoint from the occupied mask; at the leaf count it iff all O cells are covered. Ships are distinct so no symmetry division is needed. Worst case (five size-2 ships on an empty 5x5) is about 2e7 leaves, well within limits. Pitfalls: double counting length-1 ships in two orientations, and forgetting that every O must be covered while '.' cells are free.
